core_obligations: Reduce the list: the conditions on the diagonal imply the corresponding conditions on the inertia by the equivalences established for the two diagonals (proof lines 3956-3960)

First two remaining cases: quasi-separatedness or local separatedness of the inertia makes the automorphism group a decent algebraic space, hence a separated group space over the field, hence a scheme (proof lines 3961-3971)

Last case: local quasi-finiteness of the inertia makes the automorphism group locally quasi-finite over the field, which by the corresponding statement for group spaces over a field is again a scheme (proof lines 3972-3974)
proof_roadmap: (4)/(5)：G_x 准分离或局部分离 ⇒ decent ⇒ 域上群空间分离 ⇒ 是概型。
(6)：G_x → Spec(k) 局部拟有限 ⇒ 域上群空间是概型。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement gives six conditions on an algebraic stack each of which forces the automorphism group of a point to be a scheme (author lemma at source lines 3937-3954, label lemma-automorphism-group-scheme). The proof (source lines 3956-3975) reduces the conditions on the diagonal to conditions on the inertia, converts quasi-separatedness or local separatedness of the inertia into separatedness of the group space over the field via decency and concludes with the corresponding criterion for group spaces over a field, with the locally quasi-finite case handled by its own criterion (proof lines 3956-3974). The reductions and the two criteria for group spaces over a field are the substance. H3.
